 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article At 15:00 it’s kickoff for Genoa-Milan and Monza-Atalanta : matches in which all four teams are chasing crucial points that could change their seasons.
 The Grifone are looking for another victory after 3 straight wins , which would put significant distance between them and the relegation zone; the Rossoneri , meanwhile, must take advantage of the head-to-head clashes between their rivals for Champions League qualification, as well as make amends for their dreadful Europa League performance against Ferencvaros.
 OneFootball Videos
 Monza urgently need points after losing their last 3 matches , as do Atalanta , who have not won in Serie A since October 12 . Sarri’s side even drew at home against Kairat Almaty in the Conference League.
 Genoa-Milan
 Genoa Milan 08:00 GENOA (3-4-2-1): Bijlow; Marcandalli, Østigård, Vásquez; Ehizibue, Traorè, Wiafe, Ellertsson; Messias, Vitinha; Osmajić.  
 MILAN (4-4-1-1): Maignan; Gila, De Winter, Diawara, Musah; Moreira, Modrić, Rabiot, Cisse; Pulisic; Ramos.
